checks.label: Production configuration policy
checks.message: Secrets, hosts, authentication and required service variables must pass policy.

checks.label: PostgreSQL service
checks.message: Set BIOINTEL_DATABASE_URL and verify service reachability.

checks.label: Application persistence backend
checks.message: Core registries still use SQLite unless a PostgreSQL repository backend is explicitly implemented and selected.

checks.label: Redis driver
checks.message: Redis enables shared rate limits, queues and distributed caches.

checks.label: Redis service
checks.message: Set BIOINTEL_REDIS_URL and verify service reachability.

checks.label: Distributed queue backend
checks.message: The bundled worker remains a local SQLite queue unless Redis/Celery execution is implemented and selected.

checks.label: S3/MinIO object storage
checks.message: Set object-storage endpoint and credentials for managed artifacts.

checks.label: Artifact storage backend
checks.message: Reports, models and documents remain filesystem-backed unless an object-store repository is selected.

checks.label: OIDC identity verification
checks.message: Issuer configuration alone is not authentication; token verification and claims mapping are required.

checks.label: Prometheus/OpenTelemetry dependencies
checks.message: The built-in metrics endpoint works without these packages; install them for external export and traces.

checks.label: Tenant isolation architecture
checks.message: Tenant context, memberships and tenant-filtered resource repositories are required.

checks.label: Kubernetes Helm deployment
checks.message: A versioned Helm chart with probes, autoscaling, disruption budgets and network policy is required.

checks.label: Visual regression CI
checks.message: Reviewed desktop/mobile baselines and a browser CI gate protect the primary interface.
